title: 第十五章 都成狗了你第十六章死恋爱脑
slug: 兽校开局被强吻我被疯批们娇宠
content_zh:
凌厌执挑着嘴角，恶劣地笑：“我是不是太给你脸了？”
盛越垂眼，沉默。
裴殷倨傲的神情微微僵住。
他眼神依旧亢奋，但细看，其实夹杂着几分试探。
“这么多年的情分，只半管血，也不行吗？”
他细说完自己打算如何研究，给在场的人画了个大饼。
“到时候，我们的阈噬期问题可以解决，她也能更加了解自己的情况。一举两得，你有什么不乐意？”
收敛表情，裴殷声音冷得像冰渣一般，“别逼我。”
简妤被他的声音弄得心里发毛。
想到裴殷在学校拿人做实验，几次被女主撞见实验者惨死的剧情……
简妤不禁呼吸闭塞，心里慌得连唇瓣都失去了血色。
她可以死，反正这个世界只是一本书，但她不能生不如死，更不想窝囊地死在别人手上。
这时，盛越冷不丁开口：“是不是忘记放红枣了。”
“哦，好像是。”凌厌执突然放下二郎腿，贤惠地去洗了几颗枣。
裴殷脸色难看。
两个傻逼！
“咚咚咚。”
简妤捧着杯子，任由凌厌执把红枣丢进她杯中。
热气升起，沾湿了她细密的长睫，脸部轮廓逐渐变得模糊而柔和。
她的情绪渐渐稳定下来。

“先凑合凑合。”凌厌执身姿慵懒地坐回到她旁边。
两人距离很近，近得简妤呼吸略微急促了一点，就能吸入一鼻子的冷香。
她手指蜷了蜷，忍不住抬手揉揉额头，总觉得脑仁莫名其妙突突地疼。
有种不加薪资，导演硬要给她熬夜加戏的感觉。
“矫情。”裴殷冷眼看着这一幕，喝个水还要枸杞红枣。
他手上没收力，不小心捏碎了桌角。
反应过来，他摊开手，当着简妤的面，阴鸷地勾了勾嘴角。
檀木桌的碎屑木头从他手上一点点掉落。
简妤愣住，转过头，“小a，垃圾清理。”
短暂的轰鸣声后，机器人启动，顶着高冷的外表，冷酷地扫走地上的木头碎屑。
瞧着简妤低头乖巧喝水的动作，裴殷嘴角笑容僵滞，想骂脏话。
三个傻逼！
他点开空间纽，取出针管，“不想给也得给，由不得你！”
content_en:
Ling Yanzhi raised the corners of his mouth and smiled wickedly: "Am I too disrespectful to you?"
Sheng Yue lowered his eyes and remained silent.
Pei Yin's proud expression froze slightly.
His eyes were still excited, but upon closer inspection, they actually contained a bit of testing.
"After so many years of friendship, it's not okay to only have half the blood, right?"
After he elaborated on how he planned to conduct research, he made a big impression on those present.
"At that time, our Threshold Period problem can be solved, and she will be able to understand her situation better. Kill two birds with one stone, what are you unhappy about?"
Pei Yin calmed down his expression and said in a voice as cold as ice shards, "Don't force me."
Jian Yu's voice made her heart tremble.
Thinking of Pei Yin experimenting on people in school, and the heroine caught him several times and the experimenter died tragically...
Jian Yu couldn't help but feel short of breath, and she was so panicked that even her lips lost their color.
She could die, since the world was just a book anyway, but she couldn't live a life worse than death, and she didn't want to die cowardly at the hands of others.
At this time, Sheng Yue suddenly said: "Did you forget to put the red dates?"
"Oh, it seems so." Ling Yanzhi suddenly put down his legs and went to wash a few dates virtuously.
Pei Yin looked ugly.
Two idiots!
"Dong dong dong."
Jian Yu held the cup and let Ling Yanzhi throw the red dates into her cup.
The heat rose and wetted her fine long eyelashes, and the outline of her face gradually became blurred and soft.
Her mood gradually stabilized.
"Let's make do for now." Ling Yanzhi lazily sat back next to her.
The distance between the two was so close that Jian Yu could inhale the cold fragrance even if her breathing quickened a little.
She curled her fingers and couldn't help but raise her hand to rub her forehead. She always felt an inexplicable pain in her brain.
It felt like the director was forcing her to stay up late for extra scenes without increasing her salary.
"Hypocritical." Pei Yin looked at this scene coldly, drank water and asked for wolfberry and red dates.
He had no strength in his hands and accidentally crushed the corner of the table.
After reacting, he spread his hands and raised the corners of his mouth sinisterly in front of Jian Yu.
The fragments of wood from the sandalwood table fell from his hands little by little.
Jian Yu was stunned and turned her head, "Little A, clean up the garbage."
After a brief roar, the robot started up. Despite its cold appearance, it coldly swept away the wood chips on the ground.
Seeing Jian Yu's obedient movement of lowering her head to drink water, Pei Yin's smile froze and he wanted to curse.
Three idiots!
He clicked on the space button and took out the syringe, "You have to give it even if you don't want to, it's not up to you!"
